Subject: The Cascade 45L: Built for the trail, not the gear closet
Preview: 45 litres. 1.4 kg. Ripstop nylon. Here's what it does on your back.
Body: You've got a route planned. Maybe three days, maybe five. You know what you need to carry and you know what your shoulders will feel by day two.

The Northbay Cascade 45L was built around that reality.

At 1.4 kg, it won't eat into your weight budget before you've packed a single item. The 45-litre capacity handles a long weekend or a lean week — enough room for the essentials without encouraging you to overpack. The internal frame keeps the load close to your back and stable on uneven ground.

The shell is ripstop nylon with water-resistant treatment. It will handle rain and trail splash. It is not waterproof — if you're heading into sustained downpour, use a pack liner or cover. That's an honest limit worth knowing before you go.

No unnecessary add-ons. No claims we can't back up. Just a 45-litre, 1.4 kg pack built to move with you.

The Cascade 45L is available now.
